I am a young man in the North East, and this beans plot is small but important for my family's food and some market sale. The rains here can be short, so I must be careful with my spending. I will put a little fertilizer to help the crop, since the soil is tired from past seasons, and I will use manure from my goats and cattle which costs me nothing. For beans I will keep my own seed from last harvest because improved seed is costly and not always available in our market, but I will spray small pesticide against the pod borers and weevils that always trouble beans here.
